model.title: Transportation Worker Identification Credential Efficiency Act
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee, Homeland Security Committee · Rep. Troy Carter (D-LA)

summary.text: The bill would require the Transportation Security Administration to develop guidelines helping incarcerated people prepare applications for a Transportation Worker Identification Credential before their release from prison, as well as guidelines for appealing denials of the credential. The credential is required for workers needing access to secure areas at U.S. maritime facilities and vessels.
